# Evidence Grounder Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when ensuring AI outputs are grounded in retrievable evidence, adding citations to claims, mapping assertions to source documents, or detecting ungrounded statements.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [evidence-grounder-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
evidence-grounder-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@evidence-grounder` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze business processes and identify improvement opportunities
- Apply domain best practices and industry-standard frameworks
- Assess current state against maturity models and benchmarks
- Generate findings with severity classification and remediation guidance

## Industry Standards Applied

- **SOC 2 Type II**: Trust service criteria: security, availability, processing integrity
- **ISO 27001**: Information security management system (ISMS) controls
- **GDPR/CCPA**: Data privacy and protection regulatory requirements
